book_cn: 上外版选择性必修第二册
unit_cn: Unit 4 Disaster Survival 灾难求生
source: 上外版选择性必修二 Unit 4 词表(真词);IPA 标准词典英音回填;例句原创、灾难求生主题、含目标词、不超纲;多义词给多个中文释义;跳过专有名词。

words.example_en: We must take measures to protect people from disasters.
words.example_cn: 我们必须采取措施保护人们免受灾害。

words.example_en: Local residents were moved to safety before the typhoon.
words.example_cn: 当地居民在台风来临前被转移到了安全地带。

words.example_en: Fishing boats hurried back to port before the storm.
words.example_cn: 渔船在风暴来临前匆匆驶回港口。

words.example_en: Many drivers were stranded as the roads slowly flooded.
words.example_cn: 随着道路渐渐被淹,许多司机被困在了路上。

words.example_en: He eased the car to a stop when the ground began to shake.
words.example_cn: 地面开始晃动时,他缓缓把车停了下来。

words.example_en: Put on sturdy shoes before you walk through the ruins.
words.example_cn: 在走过废墟前先穿上结实的鞋子。

words.example_en: Check for broken pipes before you turn on the gas.
words.example_cn: 打开燃气前先检查有没有破损的管道。

words.example_en: Heavy objects may shift and fall during a quake.
words.example_cn: 地震时重物可能会挪动并掉落。

words.example_en: Lumps of plaster fell from the ceiling and hit his head.
words.example_cn: 一块块灰泥从天花板上掉下来砸在他头上。

words.example_en: The windows shattered as the whole building shook.
words.example_cn: 整栋楼晃动时,窗户都碎裂了。

words.example_en: Dust filled his throat and he could not even scream.
words.example_cn: 灰尘塞满了他的喉咙,他连喊都喊不出来。

words.example_en: His throat was coated with thick grey dust.
words.example_cn: 他的喉咙被一层厚厚的灰尘覆盖着。

words.example_en: The ceiling burst open right above his head.
words.example_cn: 天花板就在他头顶上方猛然裂开。

words.example_en: They leaped towards the door as the bricks fell.
words.example_cn: 砖块掉落时,他们猛地冲向门口。

words.example_en: Bricks poured down through the open doorway.
words.example_cn: 砖块从敞开的门口倾泻而下。

words.example_en: Stones and broken glass spilled into the street.
words.example_cn: 石块和碎玻璃涌进了街道。

words.example_en: They would have been buried if they had been a little slower.
words.example_cn: 如果他们再慢一点,就会被埋住了。

words.example_en: The earthquake tore through the city like a furious giant.
words.example_cn: 地震像一个狂怒的巨人般撕裂了城市。

words.example_en: Some unsteady houses collapsed soon after the shaking.
words.example_cn: 一些摇摇欲坠的房子在震动后不久就倒塌了。

words.example_en: Some people lay stretched across the sidewalk, not moving.
words.example_cn: 一些人横躺在人行道上,一动不动。

words.example_en: Their hands were black with ash after the fire.
words.example_cn: 火灾过后,他们的手被灰烬染得黑黑的。

words.example_en: His fingers were scratched raw in several spots.
words.example_cn: 他的手指好几处都被擦得红肿破皮。

words.example_en: Keep your emergency kit in an easy-to-reach spot.
words.example_cn: 把应急包放在容易拿到的地方。

words.example_en: Earthquakes can strike without any warning at all.
words.example_cn: 地震可能毫无预警地突然发生。

words.example_en: A strong typhoon struck the southern coast last night.
words.example_cn: 昨晚一场强台风袭击了南部海岸。

words.example_en: Flood water gushed through the broken wall.
words.example_cn: 洪水从破裂的墙体喷涌而入。

words.example_en: An avalanche can bury a whole village under the snow.
words.example_cn: 一场雪崩能把整个村庄埋在雪下。

words.example_en: The raging flames of the wildfire spread very quickly.
words.example_cn: 野火的熊熊烈焰蔓延得非常快。

words.example_en: Put out all flames the moment an earthquake starts.
words.example_cn: 地震一开始就要熄灭所有的火焰。

words.example_en: Keep an emergency kit ready in case of a disaster.
words.example_cn: 备好应急包,以防发生灾难。

words.example_en: Hide in a secure basement during a strong typhoon.
words.example_cn: 强台风期间要躲进牢固的地下室。

words.example_en: A basement with no windows is a safe place in a storm.
words.example_cn: 没有窗户的地下室是风暴中安全的地方。

words.example_en: Get under a solid piece of furniture to protect yourself.
words.example_cn: 躲到结实的家具下面来保护自己。

words.example_en: Fix tall furniture to the wall so it cannot fall on you.
words.example_cn: 把高大的家具固定在墙上,免得它砸到你。

words.example_en: A battery-powered radio still works when the power is off.
words.example_cn: 停电时,用电池的收音机依然能工作。

words.example_en: Follow the evacuation order and leave for higher ground.
words.example_cn: 听从撤离命令,前往地势更高的地方。

words.example_en: Floods are often caused by intense rain lasting for days.
words.example_cn: 洪水常由连日的强降雨引起。

words.example_en: When you hear the warning, move to a safer place at once.
words.example_cn: 听到警报时,立刻转移到更安全的地方。

words.example_en: Keep your papers in a waterproof container during a flood.
words.example_cn: 洪水期间把证件放在防水容器里。

words.example_en: Store clean water in a sealed container before the storm.
words.example_cn: 风暴来临前把干净水储存在密封容器里。

words.example_en: Move to the side of the slope when an avalanche starts.
words.example_cn: 雪崩开始时,移向斜坡的边缘。

words.example_en: Drop any heavy equipment so that you can move faster.
words.example_cn: 扔掉沉重的器材,这样你能跑得更快。

words.example_en: Cover your mouth with a wet cloth to ensure you can breathe.
words.example_cn: 用湿布捂住口鼻,确保你还能呼吸。

words.example_en: In a wildfire, get close to a pond or river if you can.
words.example_cn: 野火中如果可能,尽量靠近池塘或河流。

words.example_en: Move to ground that has burned out and is less likely to spark again.
words.example_cn: 移到已经烧尽、不太会再起火的地面上。

words.example_en: Cover yourself with a wet blanket until the fire passes.
words.example_cn: 用湿毯子盖住自己,直到火势过去。

words.example_en: Leave the door unlocked so firefighters can reach you.
words.example_cn: 让门开着,这样消防队员能找到你。

words.example_en: A basic survival kit should hold food, water and a torch.
words.example_cn: 一个基本的求生包应该装有食物、水和手电筒。

words.example_en: Keep a few damp towels in your emergency bag.
words.example_cn: 在应急包里放几条湿毛巾。

words.example_en: Pack a phone with backup batteries for emergencies.
words.example_cn: 带上一部配有备用电池的手机以备紧急之需。
